hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || { printf '%s\n' 'agent-guard unavailable: cannot resolve repository' >&2; exit 2; }; node "$root/.claude/hooks/agent-guard.mjs"; rc=$?; case $rc in 0|2) exit "$rc" ;; *) printf '%s\n' 'agent-guard unavailable: command check failed' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
